kjv_def: bright, clear, gay, goodly, gorgeous, white
strongs_def: radiant; by analogy, limpid; figuratively, magnificent or sumptuous (in appearance)
it_def:
1) brillante
   1a) brillante
   1b) chiaro, trasparente
2) splendido, magnifico
   2a) delle cose splendide cioè di lusso o elegante in vestito o stile
